title: 'Dad left him in charge.' Walter Payton's son, Jarrett, mourns Matt Suhey

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: 'Dad left him in charge.' Walter Payton's son, Jarrett, mourns Matt Suhey
sources.description: Matt Suhey was Bears teammate Walter Payton's best friend. "When everything felt uncertain, he was there," Jarrett Payton wrote.
